notes: I split the negative side into three regions instead of one degree-5 polynomial: a plateau polynomial for |x|≤1.65 (E12), a degree-6 hump polynomial for 1.65<|x|≤4.5 (E16/E20), and a quartic tail in |x| for |x|>4.5 (E18). The old single polynomial couldn't capture the localized bump peaking near x=-2.15, which is why E8/E10/E12/E16/E20 failed.
